version.description: The file's version the entry was made for: its inventory hash, or <size>:<mtimeMs> when it has none

file.description: The preview, a file in the previews folder

sheet.description: The image is an animation cut into frames: { fps, loop?, grid: { columns, rows?, start?, count?, cell?, origin?, gap? }, durations? } or { fps, loop?, frames: [{ region: [x, y, w, h], offset?, size?, duration? }] } (tools/jam/src/catalog/README.md, Sprite sheets)

inputs.description: Other inventory files the preview was made from (the images an animation is cut from), with the version each had; the catalog says the preview is out of date when one changed

name.description: The animation's name in the engine

file.description: The image its frames are cut from, a file in the previews folder

source.description: The project file that image is, when it is one: the catalog tells which of the project's images the engine plays this way

sheet.description: The image is an animation cut into frames: { fps, loop?, grid: { columns, rows?, start?, count?, cell?, origin?, gap? }, durations? } or { fps, loop?, frames: [{ region: [x, y, w, h], offset?, size?, duration? }] } (tools/jam/src/catalog/README.md, Sprite sheets)

animations.description: Animations the engine file holds (a sprite animation resource), each shown playing in the catalog

kind.description: image: PNG, JPEG or WebP. model: self-contained GLB. audio: WAV. video: WebM or MP4

how.description: How the adapter made it, in a few words

failed.description: Why no preview was made for this version; the adapter tries again when the file changes

EnginePreviews.title: Index of engine previews written by an adapter's previews command
